listing.name: Darius Gaiden — Extra arcade Ver 2.7J / omegakatana92 RetroFront recomp
listing.summary: Darius Gaiden Native Recomp brings Taito's classic arcade shoot-'em-up to Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck. Designed to support both the original Darius Gaiden and Extra Edition, featuring native execution, edition switching, save states, controller support, customizable settings, and modern arcade enhancements.
